name: Services
description: What is running on this computer, on which port, and whose it is: listening ports and Docker containers, tied to the worker whose port block they sit in, without a terminal.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs three read-only commands (a small Node script that lists listening ports, docker ps and docker logs), reads the workspace's panels to name a port's worker, and sends a message to a panel only when you ask an agent to stop something. It stops nothing itself.

ports.description: The TCP ports something is listening on, with the program, its pid and its start time. Reads only.

docker-list.description: Every Docker container, running or stopped. Reads only.

docker-logs.description: The last 200 lines a Docker container wrote. Reads only.

id.description: The container's id, as docker ps prints it
